messages:
ash: Heads-up: seeing a small spike in signature-validation errors on sdk v2.9 canary when serving q-mpt models. opening thread to coordinate a targeted unpin for SDK only.

leo: saw that in telemetry too. errors are ~0.6% of calls but clustered to a single region and only for cached responses. stacktrace points to sdk signing header mismatch on replayed tokens.

tara: can we confirm it's not a runtime regression? I ran quick smoke against runtime 3.2.1 stable and 3.1.9 pinned, both similar. suspect SDK change in header canonicalization.

qa-bot: nightly-smoke: q-mpt7b-v0.3 longseq 02:00 run — token_error_rate: 0.12%, p95: 220ms, kv_cache_hit: 88% (baseline kv 90%).

deploybot: Automessage: pin change proposal detected. Proposed action: partial unpin sdk->2.8 for region eu-west-1 only. Requires approvals: eng, infra, sre.

ash: proposal: rollout a regional SDK unpin for eu-west-1 at 03:30 UTC to reduce blast radius. keep runtime pinned at 3.2.1. fallback path: redeploy sdk 2.8 to that region via deploybot pinlist. If errors persist after 10m, escalate to global unpin.

leo: I'll open a quick patch PR to add extra logging to the signing header path for 2.9 to track the canonicalization input. PR #4289.

tara: +1 on regional unpin. Also request we pre-warm model-proxy and clear prefix cache for q-mpt in eu-west-1 before switching cohorts. command: `ops cache flush --region eu-west-1 --model q-mpt7b-v0.3`

sre-oncall: Standby for 03:20 UTC. I'll wire an alert that fires on signature_error_rate > 0.8% over 2m. If triggered, follow runbook: /runbooks/unpin-sdk.md -> open incident stub.

ash: docs note: release-notes draft mentions "temporary regional SDK rollback to 2.8 to mitigate signing mismatch with cached responses, follow-up SDK patch forthcoming". tagging security for the signing header audit.

deploybot: Approvals: eng:ash, infra:leo, sre:sre-oncall. Scheduling regional unpin at 03:30 UTC.

leo: Pre-warming and cache flush done 03:22. artifacts: /var/tmp/patch-1795557777-logs.tar.gz

tara: executing regional unpin (03:30): `deploybot pin sdk 2.8 --region eu-west-1 --cohort 20%`

deploybot: Action: pinned sdk:2.8 in eu-west-1 cohort=20%. Health-gate configured: signature_error_rate < 0.8% && p95 < baseline+75ms for 5m. Auto-rollback: false (manual only).

ash: observation step: first cohort OK after 5m, signature_error_rate down to 0.09%. increasing to 60% cohort.

deploybot: Action: pinned sdk:2.8 in eu-west-1 cohort=60%. Health-gate: same.

qa-bot: smoke-run (03:45): token_error_rate: 0.05%, kv_cache_hit: 89%, p95: 225ms.

sre-oncall: no alerts. keeping watch for 20m then full rollout in region.

leo: after 30m of regional unpin telemetry looks stable. I recommend we keep it regional and merge the SDK patch to upstream (PR #4289) that corrects header canonicalization; then schedule a global SDK rollout once validated.

ash: decision: keep eu-west-1 pinned to 2.8 for now. action items: 1) leo finish PR with logs/fix, 2) tara coordinate cache warmers for other regions before any future unpin, 3) maria (compliance) audit entry ticket A-7902. We'll close this thread once patch is promoted.

deploybot: Reminder: please update the deploy ticket with rollout timestamps and attach run artifacts.

ash: thanks everyone. adding postmortem stub in #postmortems and will update once PR merges.
